comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body: So, eh... once ya discover Xanadu, is it possible to return anytime, like Palenque and other land discovery places? And is it possible to take others inside for a look-see? Thanks in advance for the answers.

comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body: It is possible to return as long as you OR one of your fleetmates have the 14th Century title (doesn't have to be used). Otherwise you need to do one of the 14th Century chronoquests to access here again. :x
